name: laczynski-lui-monorepo
description: ui component library monorepo with demo application

scripts.docs:build: node scripts/generate-showcase-llms.mjs && npx tsx --tsconfig scripts/tsconfig.docs-gen.json scripts/generate-docs-metadata.ts
scripts.prestart: npm run docs:build && npm run icons:build && npm run showcase:crawl-discovery
scripts.prestart:ui-showcase: npm run docs:build && npm run icons:build && npm run showcase:crawl-discovery
scripts.prebuild: npm run docs:build && npm run icons:build && npm run showcase:crawl-discovery
scripts.prebuild:ui-showcase: npm run docs:build && npm run icons:build && npm run showcase:crawl-discovery
scripts.prebuild:gh-pages: npm run docs:build && npm run icons:build && npm run showcase:crawl-discovery
scripts.prewatch: npm run docs:build && npm run icons:build && npm run showcase:crawl-discovery
scripts.publish:lib:preview: cd dist/lui && npm publish --access public --tag preview
scripts.publish:lib:patch: cd packages/lui && npm version patch && cd ../.. && npm run build:lib && npm run publish:lib
scripts.publish:lib:minor: cd packages/lui && npm version minor && cd ../.. && npm run build:lib && npm run publish:lib
scripts.publish:lib:major: cd packages/lui && npm version major && cd ../.. && npm run build:lib && npm run publish:lib
